title: 2009 AMC 12B Problem 16
statement: Trapezoid \(ABCD\) has \(AD \parallel BC,\) \(BD = 1,\) \(\angle DBA = 23^\circ,\) and \(\angle BDC = 46^\circ.\) The ratio \(BC : AD\) is \(9 : 5.\) What is \(CD?\)

solutions.text:
Draw the line through \(D\) parallel to \(AB,\) meeting \(BC\) at \(E,\) so \(ABED\) is a parallelogram with \(BE = AD.\) Then \(\angle BDE = \angle DBA = 23^\circ,\) and since \(\angle BDC = 46^\circ,\) segment \(DE\) bisects \(\angle BDC.\)

By the angle bisector theorem in \(\triangle BDC,\) \(\dfrac{EC}{BE} = \dfrac{DC}{DB},\) so \[ \begin{aligned} CD &= DB \cdot \dfrac{BC - AD}{AD} \\ &= 1 \cdot \left(\dfrac{9}{5} - 1\right) \\ &= \dfrac{4}{5}. \end{aligned} \]

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Draw the line through \(D\) parallel to \(AB,\) meeting \(BC\) at \(E\); then \(BE = AD\)
Show \(DE\) bisects \(\angle BDC,\) then apply the angle bisector theorem in \(\triangle BDC\)
